code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    zero_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    if not zero_cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in zero_cells), max(r for r, c in zero_cells)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in zero_cells), max(c for r, c in zero_cells)
    frame = max({grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0},
                key=lambda color: sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h) for c in range(w)))
    motif_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] != frame and grid[r][c] != 0]
    mr0, mr1 = min(r for r, c in motif_cells), max(r for r, c in motif_cells)
    mc0, mc1 = min(c for r, c in motif_cells), max(c for r, c in motif_cells)
    motif = [grid[r][mc0:mc1 + 1] for r in range(mr0, mr1 + 1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(zr0, zr1 + 1):
        for c in range(zc0, zc1 + 1):
            out[r][c] = motif[r - zr0][mc1 - c + zc0]
    return out
'''

                key=lambda color: sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h) for c in range(w)))
    motif_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
